protocol: H0 matched ReLU6 anchor: K-group shared scratch MobileNetV2+R-ASPP, hard-label CE plus locked A0 feature MSE, native masked 8x16 R2 relation MSE, and frozen T1 full-resolution masked pixel KL (T=4); weights 1.0/0.3/0.5, shared 4000-step warm-up, 80k optimizer steps, dev_local selection, and no test_local evaluation.

config.eval_policy: first epoch boundary at or after each target step

loss.feature_reduction: mean per BCHW layer, then equal mean over 3 layers
loss.logit_reduction: mean over valid pixels after sum over 19 classes

teacher.type: T1 DINOv3 ConvNeXt-T + R-ASPP, shared features and logits

relation.tail_batch_policy: use the actual synchronized micro-batch; never cache, pad, or combine samples across optimizer steps
relation.mask_policy: nearest-resized valid mask, adaptive-average valid fraction, valid fraction > 0
relation.layer_aggregation: equal mean over native OS=4/8/16 relation losses

r2.reduction: sum over valid token pairs divided by valid-pair count

shape_audit.conversion: features.14 depthwise stride 2->1; features.14-17 depthwise convolutions use dilation=2 and padding=2
shape_audit.projection: fixed A0 StandardScaler+PCA, teacher to student channels
